get.description: Advertises only active exact-name publications of published resources whose governed visibility is public. GetMap accepts one to sixteen ordered advertised layer/style occurrences, including standards-defined repeats, and is deliberately cache-only: an anonymous request can read an exact immutable output that an authenticated operator prewarmed, but can never create, resubmit, or dispatch paid rendering work. Cache misses return a retryable ServerBusy service exception. The opaque service id can be disabled irreversibly through the authenticated management API.
